narrative:
## Handover Summary — Cost Base & Efficiency

Cost base locked with accepted savings reflected at business-line level.

## Key Decisions
• Retail opex -5% via branch-to-advisory-hub consolidation
• Card processing consolidated to a single vendor at 2026 renewal
• Fund operations automation funded from the change portfolio

## Recommendation for Change & Digital Investment
Several savings depend on change initiatives (Oracle → Snowflake Postgres, NAV automation). The CDO should protect these in prioritisation.

signals.title: Retail Channel Review — Branch Utilisation
signals.excerpt: 78% of retail transactions are digital; 9 branches in Inland & North average fewer than 25 visits per day.

signals.title: Pricing Tool Migration — Oracle to Snowflake Postgres
signals.excerpt: Legacy Oracle pricing tool scheduled for migration to Snowflake Postgres, removing licence cost and manual price-list reconciliation.
